short_diagnostic.status: Completed eight diagnostic references. Canonical original-F32 failures remain failures; no short-case exception approved.
method_notes: Exact matrix/cache owners are the frozen Q2 depth v3 copies. Only fixtures/schedules changed.
Older short/NLL references used division-based reconstruction and one HF thread; current frozen producer uses four. Differences cannot be attributed solely to helper correction.
Batched NLL uses 247 body/head rows and 246 targets; singleton feeds 246 body/head rows and scores 246 targets.
F32-KV batched runtime evidence contains nine-decimal CLI means, not per-target arrays.

HF_only_F16_NLL_shape_spread.interpretation: Demonstrates reference shape sensitivity; not an error allowance or gate pass.

code_case.retained_runtime_evidence: Only complete block-int16 policy witnesses, CLI top-ten outputs and receipts exist for this six-token case; no code-specific normalized inputs, packed twins, per-projection outputs or dispatch specialization trace was retained.

source_review.shared_activation_owner: vulkan_twins.hpp row_twin() routes both integer-dot formats through twin(); cache identity depends on input buffer/offset/element count and twin layout, not weight format. Same input bytes should therefore give the same packed int16 codes and scale/sum table.
source_review.expected_arithmetic_difference: Q2 forms a centered integer sum and fma(RNE(dw*dx),float(sum),acc). Q4_0 computes the uncentered nibble dot and precise d*(dx*dot-8*ds), then acc+=term; ds itself is a rounded scaled integer sum. Float centering/cancellation and accumulation differ even for byte-exact decoded weights and equal activation twins. Q4 agreement with HF does not establish greater accuracy.
source_review.emitted_order_scope: The prior 170-entry replay verifies Q2 emitted arithmetic for Rome17. Code6 has only a generic policy witness, and no corresponding Q4 machine-order audit is retained. Do not infer actual code6 specialization or Q4 FMA/rounding from source alone.

single_next_localization.status: Proposal only; no new capture, model forward, variant or build launched.
single_next_localization.earliest_unmeasured_boundary: For code6, equality of the layer-0 normalized input and the actual packed block-int16 twin consumed by the first Q/K/V products, followed by the unrounded product outputs before K/V F16 cache writes. The existing evidence does not identify a particular divergent code layer or coordinate.
single_next_localization.bounded_measurement: One code6 fixture only, Q2 and its exact-value Q4 control, unchanged F16 matrix/F16 KV policy. Capture normalized F32 inputs, actual packed int16 words plus dx/ds, actual kernel/specialization/cluster dispatch, and first-layer Q/K/V outputs before cache rounding. Use one baseline and one observer capture per arm solely to verify observation preserves full logits: at most four six-token forwards. No other prompts, seeds, cache types or HF variants.
single_next_localization.operator_analysis: Verify identical original inputs and packed twins first. Replay only the first relevant differing operator coordinate using independent GGUF-decoded weights and the actual emitted integer/F32 order. Use the validated exact-arithmetic helper for byte-exact prediction and one independent double dot of the same reconstructed F32 inputs as a diagnostic error metric. Do not replace the whole-model HF reference with double or select by agreement.
interpretation: Different normalized inputs point upstream; different twins from identical inputs localize input packing/reuse.
A Q2 product that disagrees with its emitted-order prediction localizes an implementation, dispatch or float-mode defect.
If Q2 and Q4 each match their distinct emitted arithmetic, their difference is expected rounding; compare each to the same double operator oracle and existing operator bound.
A clean first boundary closes only that localized suspicion. It does not erase the final code top-one failure or automatically authorize a walk through later layers.
single_next_localization.resources: Reuse the existing diagnostic native-capture envelope: each stage at most 4 GiB and 300 seconds, one admitted GPU4/5, production/render exclusions and 2 GiB host reserve plus live unused caps. Any scratch-only helper build is separately reviewed within its existing 4 GiB/300 s envelope. No cap expansion or automatic rerun.
single_next_localization.unchanged_gates: Original short top-one/top-five/NLL criteria remain. Both selected 16K depth gates already pass; no 512-position rerun is proposed.

short_diagnostic.independent_verdict: Reference/arithmetic sensitivity is demonstrated, including shared main/Q4 and HF-only failures. Rome localization is resolved and exact selected Rome now agrees. Code F16 remains a Q2-specific numerical suspicion because main Q4 agrees with exact HF, but its passing rank is not an arithmetic oracle. Current evidence neither proves a source bug nor proves complete Q2 correctness.
